prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
sign_in/hint changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+5.8% after noise correction).
choose_path/copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption/redesign, choose_path/layout, finish/notification, home/new_screen, and sign_in/reorder as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all Round 1 tests and for major redesigns.
Predictions were too low for the first sign_in/hint test, where measured results (+11.5%) significantly exceeded the predicted gain (+3.0%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +5.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -5.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Session Persistence Reassurance Hint: Add an explicit session persistence hint clarifying that pet data and account state are automatically saved across sessions. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in, and sign-in hints previously yielded strong conversion gains.)
1: [home, new_screen] Real-Time Companion Generation Preview Screen: Insert a dedicated waiting preview screen before system setup displaying interactive visual progress while rendering. (why: The waiting step has an exceptionally long mean time (2336s), leading to user drop-off during background generation.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Flow: Transform home_intro into a structured onboarding checklist flow showing key desktop controls and tray menu actions. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop.)
3: [home, wait_info] Background Processing Status and Estimate: Add explicit estimated completion time copy and status indicators to the waiting screen. (why: Users abandon during home step due to high mean wait time (2336s) without clear indication of background status.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Certificate Stamp Incentive: Display an official digital adoption badge on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet creation. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (65.9%); providing a sense of milestone accomplishment encourages proceeding.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop System Tray Discovery Notification: Enable desktop notification prompts on completion explaining how to summon or manage the pet from system tray. (why: Multiple support emails noted pets disappearing or users unable to locate companion controls on first desktop launch.)

scores.note: Sign-in hints have strong empirical support (+5.8% across 2 winning tests) and 8 support tickets directly request session reassurance.
Home step has extreme mean wait time, but adding new preview screens previously reduced conversion (-0.9%) and has high build cost.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users and support emails confirm post-onboarding confusion, but complex new flows carry high implementation cost and overprediction risk.
Targeting the 2336s mean wait time at home step with clear status copy is safer and lower cost than introducing a full new screen.
Adoption step has high drop-off (34.1%), and adding a badge incentive on an existing screen is low-to-moderate effort.
Strong evidence from support emails regarding lost desktop pets, though previous notification test showed a very modest lift (+0.2%).
